facts.claim: The root .env BASE_URL targets preprod while the agency-owner credentials are PROD; because loadProjectEnv does not override an already-set env var, the adhoc prod sweep must be run with BASE_URL pinned to https://icm.pieq.ai/ (otherwise login hangs at LoginPage.waitForAppHost).

As agency owner on PROD, dashboard, statement history, payables, advance overview, commissions, agency configuration, products and agents all render; 9/9 read-only sweep scenarios pass in ~55s with no mutations.
